newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan stock futures volume to increase - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stock futures volume to increase - RFTV.

text.p: Turnover on the fledging Taiwan stock market futures contracts launched on Thursday will increase as investors get used to them, Reuters Financial Televison (RFTV) was told.
"I would expect more volume to come in as people get used to the contracts," Richard Fan, Assistant Director at W.I. Carr in Hong Kong told RFTV.
Trading began in both Chicago and Singapore on Thursday on two different futures contracts designed to offer overseas investors a hedge on the Taiwan stock market.
